_README: Библиотека эффектов. Хранит сырые CSS-анимации, фильтры и стили, на которые ссылается director-config.json.

fonts.jura: @font-face { font-family: 'Jura'; src: url('https://fonts.gstatic.com/s/jura/v31/z73dXa3aW78m7xTf_G2pI-4.woff2') format('woff2'); font-weight: normal; font-style: normal; }

textStyles.retro_box: font-family: 'Jura', sans-serif !important; font-size: 72px!important; color: #b0b0b0; background-color: #111111; padding: 0 0.5em 0.2em 0.5em; margin: 0.5em 0; line-height: 1.5; -webkit-box-decoration-break: clone; box-decoration-break: clone;

globalFilters.invert_neon_blue: backdrop-filter: invert(100%) contrast(160%) sepia(80%) hue-rotate(180deg) saturate(200%);
globalFilters.color_burn_power: backdrop-filter: contrast(145%) brightness(92%) sepia(15%) hue-rotate(-5deg) saturate(120%); mix-blend-mode: multiply;
globalFilters.color_burn_effect2: backdrop-filter: contrast(220%) brightness(85%) sepia(30%) hue-rotate(-10deg) saturate(150%); mix-blend-mode: multiply;
globalFilters.color_burn_middle: backdrop-filter: contrast(120%) brightness(96%) sepia(8%) hue-rotate(-2deg) saturate(105%); mix-blend-mode: multiply;
globalFilters.color_burn_low: backdrop-filter: contrast(110%) brightness(105%) sepia(2%) saturate(100%); mix-blend-mode: multiply;

colorGrading.neon_noir: background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(15, 20, 60, 0.6) 0%, rgba(60, 15, 80, 0.4) 100%); mix-blend-mode: overlay;
colorGrading.dark_purple_lut: background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(42, 16, 64, 0.35) 0%, rgba(20, 5, 30, 0.5) 100%); mix-blend-mode: screen;

noiseStyles.soft_white: background-image: url("data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg viewBox='0 0 200 200' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%3E%3Cfilter id='n'%3E%3CfeTurbulence type='fractalNoise' baseFrequency='0.8' numOctaves='3' stitchTiles='stitch'/%3E%3C/filter%3E%3Crect width='100%25' height='100%25' filter='url(%23n)'/%3E%3C/svg%3E"); mix-blend-mode: screen; opacity: 0.15; animation: filmJitter 0.3s steps(3) infinite;

lighting.static_lamp: background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(255, 245, 230, 0.15) 0%, rgba(30, 20, 10, 0.5) 100%); mix-blend-mode: overlay;
lighting.dynamic_lamp: background: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 50%, rgba(255, 240, 220, 0.25) 0%, rgba(10, 15, 20, 0.8) 60%); mix-blend-mode: overlay; animation: swingingLamp 14s ease-in-out infinite alternate, dustPump var(--total-dur) linear forwards;

svgFilters.ribbon_edge:
<svg style="position: absolute; width: 0; height: 0;" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <filter id="ribbon-edge">
    <feTurbulence type="fractalNoise" baseFrequency="0.04" numOctaves="3" result="noise" />
    <feDisplacementMap in="SourceGraphic" in2="noise" scale="4" xChannelSelector="R" yChannelSelector="G" />
    <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="1.5" result="blurred" />
  </filter>
</svg>
